The parameter set a run was made from

Source: R/load.R
load_params.Rd

Reads params.tsv (params.tsv) into a vivax_params() object holding every parameter, in order and of its type: run_sim(load_params(run), seed = run$seed, outdir = tempfile()) gives the same run again. Values are not checked here (run_sim() checks them). The seed, the versions, the derived genome and the outcome rows are on the load_run() object instead.

Usage

load_params(run)

Arguments

run

a run: a vivax_run (from run_sim() or load_run()) or the path of a run directory.

Value

a vivax_params() object.

Details

A file from another version of the package can lack some parameters, which take their defaults, or hold rows that are not parameters, which are left out. Either warns, once per directory per session, with class malariafwd_params_mismatch.

Examples

p <- load_params(example_run())
p
#> <vivax_params> 63 parameters
#>   non-default:
#>     SIM_DAYS                 = 400
#>     N_HOSTS                  = 60
#>     N_FOUNDER_HOSTS          = 16
#>     N_FOUNDER_LINEAGES       = 10
#>     N_MOSQ                   = 150
#>     LAMBDA_OOCYSTS           = 1
#>     LAMBDA_SPOROZOITES       = 1.5
#>     RADCURE_COVERAGE         = 0.3
#>     BLOODCURE_COVERAGE       = 0.5
#>     P_BLOODCURE_SURVIVAL     = 0.1
#>     P_RECRUD_GIVEN_FAIL      = 0.5
#>     P_DETECT_RELAPSE         = 0.5
#>     IMPORT_START             = 1
#>     IMPORT_RATE_PER_TICK     = 0.05
if (FALSE) { # slim_available()
run <- run_sim(p, seed = 3, outdir = tempfile("seed3"))   # the same settings, another seed
}
